title: Seedance 2.0で720p・15s設定で生成し、CapCutで編集するワークフローにする
content:
Seedance 2.0で720p・15s設定で生成し、CapCutで編集するワークフローにする
引用元のプロンプトを修正して新しい殺陣シーンを作る
背景を多めに生成しておき、複数シーンを作ってから編集でまとめる

en.content:
Use a workflow where you generate in Seedance 2.0 at 720p and 15s, then edit in CapCut.
Revise the source prompt to create a new sword-fighting scene.
Generate plenty of background footage in advance, create multiple scenes, and then combine them in editing.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
Good morning.

Thanks to your support, I’ve surpassed 1,200 followers!
Thank you always for the likes, reposts, and replies.
I’m truly grateful!

I keep posting world-building content that’s hard to understand and driven by my own satisfaction, without knowing where the demand is.
If you’d like, I’d be happy if you continue to watch.
Thank you very much.
